opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or recently displaced, regardless of nationality, who are being forced to flee by the risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death. Applications considered on a rolling basis.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission for academics in immediate danger, working with a Network of 135 universities and research institutes to secure temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements (2- or 3-year awards as standard) at UK universities and research institutions, providing financial support, fee waivers, visa help and other practical arrangements until fellows can return home.
